# Taskrabbit + GB Visual Editor
Date: 2026-08-26 | Duration: 24m

## Summary
The meeting provided a comprehensive demonstration of Growthbook’s Visual Editor, highlighting its user-friendly features such as full experiment management through a Chrome extension, which blends AI suggestions with manual edits for flexible testing of webpage elements. Key integrations with Figma facilitate the import of design elements, enabling efficient visual updates and rapid prototyping. AI-powered image editing allows users to generate and swap images hosted on Growthbook’s CDN swiftly, speeding up creative iterations. The platform also emphasizes granular experiment targeting, including geo-targeting and user attribute targeting for localized marketing strategies. Additionally, CDN-level SDK integration is recommended to reduce page flicker during tests, while the Growthbook team’s quick responsiveness to user feedback fosters improved features and builds trust.

## Keywords
Visual Editor, A/B Testing, Homepage Redesign, Figma Integration, Client-Side Testing, Geographic Targeting
